## 6. Camping Olivella — inexpensive Pilzone-cluster fallback, with an access caveat

**Location:** Via Cave 7, Pilzone d’Iseo
**Official website / prices:** <https://www.campingolivella.it/> · <https://campingolivella.it/prezzi-pricing.html>  
**2026 season:** 20 March–25 October

Olivella sits directly on the lake in the same Via Cave cluster as Lagovivo, Camping Pilzone and Camping Cave. Its official site describes **large shaded pitches for caravans and campers**, shallow lake water, wastewater disposal and a boat ramp. It also explicitly states that it has an arrangement with **Lago Vivo Green Rental** “a due passi dal campeggio” — effectively a short walk away. The page specifically mentions kayaks/electric boats, while Lagovivo's own current operation separately confirms SUP rental, so the SUP advantage is the same nearby dedicated operator used by Pilzone/Cave rather than a campsite-owned fleet.

The price is unusually attractive for 2 September. The official 2026 table places 2 September in peak season. **Zone A** is clear at €17 for the pitch plus €9 per adult, with €1 tourist tax per adult: about **€37/night for two adults**. The site's Italian and English columns conflict slightly for **Zone B** (adult/pitch figures differ by €1), so the honest comparison is **about €47–50/night including tourist tax** rather than pretending there is one exact number. Electricity, showers, hot water and private parking are included in the pitch tariff.

There is one material downside for a rental camper: a current June/July 2026 camper review specifically describes **tight access and cramped manoeuvring**, especially for larger motorhomes; another current review describes the site as quiet, shaded and clean. For a medium camper, ask for the exact access route and pitch dimensions before booking.

**Best for:** low price, direct lake access, Lagovivo proximity, people happy with a small traditional campsite.  
**Downside:** access/manoeuvring can be awkward; facilities/reviews are more mixed than Pilzone; direct SUP rental is nearby rather than owned by Olivella.

---

## 7. Riva di San Pietro — best Marone / northern-east-shore base

**Location:** Via Battista Cristini 5, Marone  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.rivasanpietro.it/>  
**2026 season:** 9 May–30 September  
**Scale:** 110 pitches

Riva di San Pietro sits directly on the lake and has electricity on all pitches, two pools, restaurant/bar, bicycle rental and pedal-/motor-boat rental. It is a good base if you want to spend more time in the northern half of the lake rather than around Iseo town.
For SUP, **Surface SUP Academy is at Lido Mad Hops, Via Battista Cristini 13**, only a few doors from the campsite at number 5. Its 2026 rental page offers All-Round and faster Superior/Race boards; an All-Round board is **€12.50/1h, €22/2h, €33/3h or €65/day**, plus a €3.50 seasonal Guest membership. This is one of the clearest dedicated-rental setups in the guide.

The campsite itself gives an important access instruction for vehicles: **do not take the Zone/Marone exit from the main road; use the Vello exit instead**.

**2 September booking note:** Exact pitch inventory is not publicly exposed, and I could not verify a clean official 2026 touring-pitch tariff; obtain a direct quote. The third-party budgeting estimate is retained only in the consolidated comparison table above.

**Official site:** <https://www.rivasanpietro.it/?lang=en&page_id=59>

**Best for:** Marone, north-lake exploration, SUP tuition, families wanting a pool.  
**Downside:** no verified on-site SUP rental; shorter season than the Iseo campsites.

## 8. Camping Iseo — best quiet sandy beach; no dogs

**Location:** Via Ippolito Antonioli 57, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.campingiseo.it/en/home-english/>  
**2026 season:** 28 March–18 October *(confirmed independently on Camping Iseo’s own 2026 tariff page)*  
**Scale:** 56 pitches

Camping Iseo is a genuinely separate site from neighbouring Camping Quai. Its official site describes a **fine-sand beach with a gentle gradient**, two lake-access ramps/jetties and a very quiet, garden-like setting. This is arguably one of the best places for launching your own SUP, especially if you prefer sand to a wall, steps or pebble edge.

Peak 2026 pricing is **€28 small pitch, €36 medium, €40 lakefront, €54 XL**, plus **€14.50 per adult and €3 electricity**. A lakefront pitch for two adults therefore comes to roughly **€72/night before tourist tax**.

Rules are stricter than elsewhere: **dogs are not allowed**, ACSI is not accepted, and the site says tents/closed awnings/grass carpets are not accepted.


**2 September booking note:** Live inventory is not publicly exposed; confirm directly. The campsite remains in its top tariff period on 2 September. See the consolidated availability/price table above.

**Official site:** <https://www.campingiseo.it/en/home-english/>

**Best for:** quiet couples, own-SUP users, sandy/shallow access, walking into Iseo.  
**Downside:** no dogs, strict camping rules, relatively high peak-season total price.
